verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents AI agents that choose and call tools, including connectors and any MCP server. Its API also offers an OpenAI-compatible chat surface that routes across Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini and OpenRouter models. However, the evidence frames agents as standalone units run by triggers, not as LLM or agent steps embedded inside a multi-step workflow, and model choice is shown only at the API level. missing for 10: documentation of agent/LLM nodes placed inside a workflow canvas, per-step model selection in the builder, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI agent or LLM steps inside a workflow, with model choice and tool use

citations.quote: You give an agent a goal and a set of tools, and it figures out how to get there: which tools to call, in what order, and when to ask you for input.
This lets you extend your agents with specialized tools, internal services, or any MCP-compatible API.
client.chat.completions.create(...) is an OpenAI-compatible chat surface that routes to every model Gumloop supports (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, OpenRouter routes).
Open the Connectors section and add the integrations the agent needs (Gmail, Salesforce, Slack, and so on).
